definition: A commitment to design, retrofit or construct infrastructure so that it withstands climate and disaster hazards: flood-proofing, elevation, hardening, wind resistance, heat-resilient design, drainage, and resilient engineering standards written into designs or specifications. Counts when a specific design measure is financed or required. Where the infrastructure goes is a separate measure (climate-informed siting); assessing the risk is another (climate risk assessment). Does not count: general references to resilient infrastructure with no design intervention named.
note: First cut from Dev's measure template, 2026-10-20; patterns anchored to a climate or energy word where the bare word would match thousands of sentences.
